pages.text: GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR SPACE ZAP UPRIGHT INSTALLATION i. 2 3. LINE Remove shipping cleats: located on bottom of cabinet. Install four (4) provided leg levelers to bottom of cabinet and level cabinet. The power is controlled by a switch located on the back of the cabinet in the top right hand corner. Plug into A.C. only, 115 volts, 60 cycles. VOLTAGE SAFETY SWITCH A line voltage safety, switch has been provided for your protection. It is located on the right rear side of the cabinet. When the back door is removed, it opens the circuit to the line voltage. To restore power (when servicing) pull switch fully out. VOLTAGE CONTROL POTS Located on power supply board (P.C. A082-90411-A000) and are preset at the factory. These pots should not be tampered with unless the distributor service department is contacted. TO SERVICE CONTROL PANEL 1. 2. 38. Open coin box door. Release two (2) clamps located above coin door opening. Disconnect control cable jack before removing. VOLUME CONTROL Located on audio amplifier P.C. board controls the volume of all sounds and may be varied as desired by rotating pot control. The audio amplifier board is located inside the front door for easy access. MO51-00902-A005
